newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-FTSE 100 poised to rise to new peak.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-FTSE 100 poised to rise to new peak.

text.p: The FTSE 100, within striking distance of its record high, is poised to reach a new peak, technical analysts said.
The leading blue chip index gained 17.8 points on Monday to close at 3,910.8.
"The market is not overbought at this stage," said Matthew Bounds, a technical analyst with London-based Exchange & Treasury Research Ltd.
He said the FTSE 100 would likely encounter technical resistance starting at 3,920 to its record high at 3,922.1.
Chart support is pegged at 3,855 to 3,836.
The FTSE 100, Bounds added, could climb as high as 3,965 during the next couple of weeks before consolidating.
"I think we'll pause for a bit after getting to 3,960 or 3,965, and then I think there's a good chance at 4,000 ... definitely before the end of the year.
"But if it closed below 3,836, it would look like the market peaked out," he added.
Chartwatchers said the FTSE 100 could pull back in the next few sessions to fill the gap on the daily bar charts between Friday's high at 3,893 and yesterday's low at 3,901.0.
But they said pulling back to fill that gap would not disturb the bullish pattern.
